plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: Session retrospective — migrate memory facts to AGENTS.md, capture session learnings, audit docs freshness, propose skills/hooks/permission updates

plugins.name: claude-statusline-state
plugins.description: Publish per-session Claude Code lifecycle state (idle/working/waiting) to a file, ready to render as an extra line in your statusline

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: Daily work orchestration — morning briefing, mid-day diff, end-of-day summary, and a standup recap (Toggl + git + GitHub) across Todoist/ClickUp/GitHub/Calendar

plugins.name: dockerize
plugins.description: Add Docker to a project: multi-stage Dockerfile, .dockerignore, optional docker-compose.yml with detected services

plugins.name: launchpad-fix
plugins.description: Re-register macOS apps missing from Launchpad with Launch Services and reset the Dock

plugins.name: semver-release
plugins.description: Cut a semver release from Conventional Commits: bump version, update CHANGELOG.md, tag, push, optional GitHub release

plugins.name: conventional-commit
plugins.description: Create a Conventional Commits message from the staged diff (type, optional scope, subject, body for non-trivial diffs)

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Bootstrap a new project: .gitignore, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md, initial commit, optional GitHub remote

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Structured code review with severity codes (Cx/Mx/mx/nx), per-round findings files, and GitHub posting

plugins.name: tmux-hooks
plugins.description: Set tmux pane title to reflect Claude Code lifecycle state

plugins.name: mikrotik-audit
plugins.description: Read-only security audit for Mikrotik RouterOS devices via SSH

plugins.name: session-log
plugins.description: Save a structured summary of each Claude Code session to a markdown file

plugins.name: session-tracker
plugins.description: Start and stop time tracking sessions in Toggl Track or Clockify

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Get a second opinion from Gemini or GPT on any important topic or decision

plugins.name: desktop-notify
plugins.description: Desktop notifications when Claude Code waits for your response or approval
